sources.recipe.test.ts:
import { it, expect } from 'vitest'
import 'bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.css'
import { server } from 'vitest/browser'
it('runs Chromium with Bootstrap and a failing control', async () => {
  const element = document.createElement('div')
  element.className = 'collapse'
  document.body.append(element)
  const hidden = getComputedStyle(element).display
  element.className = ''
  const visible = getComputedStyle(element).display
  console.log('RECIPE', JSON.stringify({ua:navigator.userAgent, hidden, visible}))
  await server.commands.writeFile('tmp/probes/recipe.json', JSON.stringify({ua:navigator.userAgent, hidden, visible}))
  expect(hidden).toBe('none')
  expect(visible).not.toBe('none')
  element.remove()
})
